kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِسْتَنْتَجَ • (istantaja) X (non-past يَسْتَنْتِجُ (yastantiju), verbal noun اِسْتِنْتَاج (istintāj))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From نَتَجَ (nataja, “to proceed, to ensue”). cf. نَتِيجَة (natīja, “result”) and أَنْتَجَ (ʔantaja, “to produce”).
g: to infer, to deduce, to conclude
